narrative.overview: A night-time bookkeeping page: deep navy ground, ruled lines instead of boxes, and one green that means action. The hero proves the product with a real capture of the /pdv screen in an application window. Desktop-first; mobile stacks the same single column. Login and sign up use the same world: two columns from 960px (brand side on ground with headline, three allowed claims and a cropped real capture; form side on lifted surface), one column on a phone.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal layering with hairline rules
Real product capture in an application window as the one raised surface
No authored motion; only a button hover transition
Auth screens: ground brand side, lifted surface form side, segmented tabs, 48px fields, 44px minimum targets

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green marks an action or a confirmed state, never decoration. Red appears only as the error state on forms.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every money figure and counter the landing sets uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The One Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the application window is raised.

rules.name: The Real Capture Rule
rules.body: The product screen must be a real capture of the app with demo data, and always carries the "Exemplo:" caption. public/landing/pdv-desktop.webp: Playwright capture of the built app's /pdv at 1280x760, device scale 1.5, invented demo data via intercepted API responses, WebP, about 100 KB; nothing from production or real customers.

rules.name: The Allowed Claims Rule
rules.body: Auth copy states only what the product does: owner PIN of 6 digits for estornos and fiado above the limit, fiado limit per customer, cash close comparing counted with expected, simple cash sales kept offline. No profit, reports, prices, customers, ratings or testimonials.

dos: Do show the product through a real demo-data capture with the "Exemplo:" caption.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for any motion added.
Do use surface only for the lifted auth form side and active tab; keep inputs on ground.
Do keep field labels as nouns, reuse the landing's words ("Criar conta"), and set autoComplete on every field.
Do pass fontClassName to AuthShell so the display face loads.
Do keep every control at least 44px.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use rows of same-size icon cards.
Don't draw an imitation of the product screen or use real-customer data.
Don't put a pill, eyebrow or kicker above a heading on any screen.
Don't show the browser's number spin buttons on money inputs.
Don't use red for anything but form errors.
